summary: This episode discusses several topics including a new initiative providing seed funding, training, and mentorship to creators with connections to marginalized communities, spearheaded by Jenna Weiss-Berman (Pineapple Street Media) and Amit Dashi (IVM Podcasts). It also highlights PRX’s involvement and encourages listeners to apply to learn more. Furthermore, it mentions attending Sound Education Conference in Boston and encourages Boston listeners to connect for potential meetups, recommends listening to “16 Shots” podcast covering the Van Dyke trial, and emphasizes the importance of using #PodsInColor to promote podcasts with diverse voices.
